name: jyotish-engine
description: Open-source, client-side Vedic (Jyotish) chart engine and life-blueprint report generator. Computes entirely in-browser; no birth data ever leaves the user's device.

notes.ephemeris: @swisseph/browser chosen after empirical evaluation (see DECISIONS.md) -- computeRawPositions() in src/engine/ephemeris.ts is not yet wired to it. astro-sweph and swisseph-wasm were evaluated and rejected.
notes.geocoding: GeoNames cities15000 dataset is not yet bundled. See data/README.md for the download step (requires network access this environment doesn't have — do this step in Claude Code, not in a sandboxed chat session).
